item.title: replication
item.description: Mïmis is an append-only store. The ID of any given node in the graph is the CID of that node in the CBOR-DAG representation of the update. Each node has a link to the PREVIOUS version which points to the update node that was the most current when the update was published.

item.title: Couriers
item.description: The courier network was launched toward the beginning of the revolution & relied on networks of drivers & custodians that were completely blind to what they were transporting ...

item.title: Ground Floor
item.description: Entry into the first public iterations of the revolution was in part through intake of substances into the Black Team’s control. There were two paths of induction: prescribers & patients.

item.title: Shot Cops
item.description: There was a system for people to report when they planned on firing a gun & where. Areas like shooting ranges were exempt to allow for privacy. When an unannounced shot was reported, Shot Cops would respond.

item.title: Don't Look Back
item.description: Prior to the Technoanarchists’ revolution, the most common form of state-sponsored consequence of undesired actions was incarceration. The punishee was housed with other “inmates” in small concrete cells generally for a period of years.

item.title: The Revolution Will Be Live
item.description: March 14, 2026 was what many consider to be the true start of the Technoanarchists’ Revolution. The scene is an impromptu ICE raid taking place at a bodega in New York City.
